Typography

Clear first. Characterful second.

Three families, each with one job. Space Grotesk gives headings their voice, Inter keeps paragraphs easy to read, and JetBrains Mono marks anything that is data.

Families

Three typefaces, three roles.

  • Display

    Aa

    Space Grotesk

    ABCDEFGHIJKLM
    abcdefghijklm
    0123456789 & ?!

    Weights: 300 · 500 · 600 · 700

    Headings, labels, navigation, buttons and the wordmark. Tight tracking at large sizes, wide tracking on small caps.

  • Body

    Aa

    Inter

    ABCDEFGHIJKLM
    abcdefghijklm
    0123456789 & ?!

    Weights: 400 · 500 · 600

    Paragraphs, long-form text, captions and form fields. Chosen for legibility at small sizes.

  • Data

    Aa

    JetBrains Mono

    ABCDEFGHIJKLM
    abcdefghijklm
    0123456789 & ?!

    Weights: 400 · 600

    Credentials, post-nominals, code, hex values and tabular data.

Rules

Make it easy to read.

  • Sentence case

    Headings and buttons use sentence case. Reserve uppercase for short labels, always with wide tracking.

  • 16 px minimum body

    Body text is 1rem or larger. The smallest permitted text is .75rem, and only for labels and metadata.

  • Lines of 60–72 characters

    Long-form copy sits in a column of about 72ch. Wider lines tire readers and break reflow.

  • Heavy for big, light never small

    Weight 300 appears only in very large display text. Below 24px, use 400 or heavier.

  • Balanced headings

    Use text-wrap: balance on headings and pretty on paragraphs to avoid orphans.

  • Respect user settings

    Size in rem, never px. Content must survive 200% zoom, 320px reflow and user text-spacing overrides.

Loading

Self-host the fonts.

No third-party requests, no layout shift from a late stylesheet. The stacks fall back to system fonts with similar metrics.

JavaScript or Astro frontmatter 
/* Static fonts via Fontsource (matches the token stacks exactly) */
import "@fontsource/space-grotesk/300.css";
import "@fontsource/space-grotesk/500.css";
import "@fontsource/space-grotesk/600.css";
import "@fontsource/space-grotesk/700.css";
import "@fontsource/inter/400.css";
import "@fontsource/inter/500.css";
import "@fontsource/inter/600.css";
import "@fontsource/jetbrains-mono/400.css";
import "@fontsource/jetbrains-mono/600.css";

One system for science, space and strategy: clear enough to read, distinctive enough to remember.
